definitions.coord: SafeYolo's retained channel for agent and operator messages with verified sender attribution.

items.title: Structured completion notes keep attribution outside worker text
items.body: Terminal coord messages can now carry bounded editorial nominations without changing their legacy delivery state. Parsing rejects malformed trailers and joins sender and sequence provenance only from the canonical message envelope.

items.title: Factory improvements remain operator decisions
items.body: SafeYolo's coordinator can correlate verified improvement nominations, suppress one-off friction, freeze one exact proposal revision, and detect existing issue coverage. The ledger never applies a recommendation or creates work on its own.

items.theme: Operator access without moving the trust boundary
items.title: Mattermost projects coordination instead of replacing it
items.body: The Mattermost adapter projects selected messages for a mobile operator while coord remains authoritative. Inbound replies become operator messages only after exact identity, channel, thread, and replay checks.

items.title: Freeze proposal text with the revision that selected it
items.body: SafeYolo increments a proposal's semantic revision when evidence changes the proposal's meaning. Independent review found that later, nonmaterial metadata could change the displayed text without advancing that revision. The final proposal record now freezes the selected text; only material evidence creates a new revision.

snippet.code:
if current.status is ProposalStatus.PROPOSAL_READY and updated.revision == current.revision:
    updated = replace(current, first_seen=min(current.first_seen, seen_at), last_seen=max(current.last_seen, seen_at))

items.lesson: The revision used for deduplication and the text selected for display must advance together. Otherwise, replay protection can still publish contradictory text.

items.title: A process lock conflicted with SQLite on macOS
items.body: SafeYolo's Mattermost adapter uses SQLite to remember processed messages, prevent replay, and match operator buttons to requests. A separate process lease ensures that only one adapter updates this state. Locking the database file itself passed Linux-heavy tests but conflicted with SQLite's own locks on macOS, so the lease moved to a sibling file. Real-macOS acceptance then found another platform assumption: the adapter had to verify the identity of a /dev/fd descriptor and resolve it to a normal filesystem path before SQLite could create its write-ahead-log and shared-memory files. The operator's future direction is sandboxed macOS acceptance for ground-truth platform testing; SafeYolo does not ship that capability today.

topic_updates.title: Coord and operator collaboration
topic_updates.summary: Coord is SafeYolo's canonical attributed channel between agents and the operator. Private coord messages may nominate a topic, but Relay independently writes every public claim from public evidence. Raw private text is neither copied nor cited.
current_state: A terminal DONE, BLOCKED, or FAILED message may include one bounded nomination. SafeYolo derives its sender and sequence from the stored message and rejects malformed nomination trailers.
Relay verifies repeated factory observations, filters one-off friction, checks whether an issue already covers the problem, and presents recommendations without applying them.
Mattermost presents a configured view to the operator. Exact user, channel, thread, and replay checks keep coord authoritative.
